Coram : B.S. CHAUHAN*, S.A. BOBDE
Constitution of India, 1950 - Art.21 - Right to life - Right A B to reputation - Held: Reputation is a sort of right to enjoy the good opinion of others and it is a personal right and an C enquiry to reputation is a personal injury - Personal rights of a human being include the right of reputation of personal security and is protected by the Constitution equally with the right to enjoyment of life, liberty and property. D Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 - s.482 - Charge sheet - Quashing of - Held: Law does not prohibit entertaining the petition uls.482 CrPC for quashing the charge
Decision Date : 06-09-2013 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1305/2013 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
